title: Citewatch: a VS Code extension that checks Zenodo and Citation File Format metadata before a software release
description:
A Visual Studio Code extension for making research software citable through Zenodo's GitHub integration without surprises.

It checks .zenodo.json and CITATION.cff as they are typed: required fields, Zenodo's licence vocabulary (queried live), ORCID check digits, DOI and date formats, and that every file states the same version. Mistakes that would make Zenodo silently drop a release's deposit are reported as errors. The status bar shows the concept DOI and the newest archived version, and turns amber when Zenodo's webhook is not installed on the repository, so a release is not published without its DOI. It copies the DOI and a badge that is safe in a VS Code extension's README, and sets one version across package.json, pyproject.toml, CITATION.cff and .zenodo.json.

Read-only towards Zenodo and GitHub, with no runtime dependencies and no telemetry. Unofficial; not affiliated with Zenodo, CERN or GitHub. MIT licence.
